title: Elodie and the Thorn
author: Dominic Eastwick
blurb: Zephyrine Nystrom, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
